en.title: Training a Small Transformer in 1.5 Hours That Beats Many LLMs
en.hook: Engineering breakthroughs in training a compact transformer in just 1.5 hours that outperforms numerous existing LLMs.
key_takeaways: Extremely short training time of 1.5 hours with high efficiency
Compact model design and architecture optimization strategies
Proving superior cost-effectiveness and practicality over large models
